metadata.coordinate_processing: New roads: HK1980 geographic to WGS84 (EPSG:4611 to EPSG:4326). Existing roads pinned by stable ROUTE_ID to the retained source snapshot; over 400 shared sections validate the datum within 2.5 cm. Connected endpoints checked after conversion.
metadata.note: Original XY preserved in approximate local metre coordinates. ELEVATION is a relative road level, not metres. Depth 32 m, widths (6 m elevated carriageways; 12 m at the low Hung Hing / Tonnochy approach), 5.6 m tunnel interior and 7 m elevated decks with cosine ramps over 150 m outside shared level junction aprons are authored. Aprons extend until adjoining centreline branches separate by 7.5 m. Shorelines derive from LandsD iB1000 with recorded gap repairs. Turn restrictions are not inferred.

island_coast_metadata.processing: HK1980 Grid EPSG:2326 northing/easting to WGS84; approximate local metre projection; 1 mm topology grid; coast simplified within 0.25 m. Straight source gaps and map cuts are authored. Island: pier outlines included, 10 cm topology weld; ferry-terminal and tunnel-mouth joins up to 120 m are explicitly authored.

coast_metadata.processing: HK1980 Grid EPSG:2326 northing/easting to WGS84; local metre projection; 1 mm topology grid; western mainland exterior simplified within 0.25 m. Short straight source gaps are recorded; northern/eastern map cuts and inland fill are authored.

northwest_coast_metadata.processing: HK1980 Grid EPSG:2326 northing/easting to WGS84; approximate local metre projection; 1 mm topology grid; coast simplified within 0.25 m. Straight source gaps and map cuts are authored.

kwai_chung_coast_metadata.processing: HK1980 Grid EPSG:2326 northing/easting to WGS84; approximate local metre projection; 1 mm topology grid; coast simplified within 0.25 m. Straight source gaps and map cuts are authored.

tsuen_wan_coast_metadata.processing: HK1980 Grid EPSG:2326 northing/easting to WGS84; approximate local metre projection; 1 mm topology grid; coast simplified within 0.25 m. Straight source gaps and map cuts are authored. Tsuen Wan: source pier outlines included; recorded terminal and seawall joins up to 60 m are authored.

west_coast_metadata.rock_outline_selection: RKA outlines connected within 0.1 m to shoreline/seawall/pier source features
west_coast_metadata.processing: HK1980 Grid EPSG:2326 northing/easting to WGS84; approximate local metre projection; 1 mm topology grid; coast simplified within 0.25 m. Straight source gaps and map cuts are authored. Ting Kau / Sham Tseng: source pier and connected rocky-shore outlines included; recorded joins up to 120 m are authored.
